reviews.text: Thank you so much for your 5-star review Juline! ⭐ We truly appreciate your kind support and are so happy to be part of Luigi's care journey. Our team is always here to provide the best care for your furry family members. Thank you for trusting us with their health and well-being! 🐾❤️ - Team Roncy! …
Great clinic! Friendly and kind staff that really care about what they do. Would recommend!

Very good experience in every aspect.

1. Easy initial communication and booking. I called, spoke with friendly and clear assistant and got an appointment couple days from my call.
2. Great check-in, lovely front desk staff. They were very sweet and fawned over my dog. As much as I’d like to believe it’s my dog I think it’s also them.
3. The visit itself of course. Now, this is an endorsement directly of Dr Jordy. I actually followed him to this clinic from another clinic because he’s the best most caring vet we’ve ever seen. He is very thorough and kind and takes time to check everything and explain everything.
4. Prices. Comprehensive senior panel for my little senior was much less than quoted elsewhere I considered it! His monthly injections was about the same.
5. Turnaround and follow up were very clear and very thorough.

Excellent clinic. I’d confidently recommend to any fellow pet owner.

Thank you so much for the wonderful 5-star review ! ⭐️ We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.

It means so much to our entire team to know that you had a positive experience at our clinic. We’re so grateful for your trust and support, and we look forward to seeing you both again! 🐾 - Team Roncy

We've been bringing our two cats to Roncy Village Vets for several years. They always give excellent service with great care and attention to our pets. They never try to upsell you for features and services we don't need.Everyone there is very kind and professional.

I enjoyed that I got to help hold my anxious cat during his checkup to calm him down. The vet was easy to talk to and the whole staff was very welcoming

After some not especially good experiences with vets I was very pleased to have lots of options, shared with me, including the least expensive. I felt listened to, and my dog was treated beautifully -  a terrific experience all around.

We have a particularly spicy cat who requires special handling even when we medicate her with gabapentin prior to her vet appointments. The team at Roncy Village Veterinary are amazing with her! The appointments move slowly—no one is grabbing her to get things over with. I was impressed with the way everyone worked with her rather than against her. There was a lot of understanding and good humor about the kind of spicy cat she is. We’re so lucky that this is our neighborhood veterinary clinic!
Received the first vaccines for a kitten. She seemed indifferent to the whole process and nade mevoay for everything. Not the worst date I've ever been on.
Amazing service
Always very caring, professional advice. You can trust your pet is getting the best possible care.

Please Roncy Village Vet do not contact me to ask me to edit this. We came here and loved it for a couple of years for our aging corgi. But the last senior check up a couple of months ago was weird. People were different, and my mentioning our previous doctor by first name made people come up blank. Then I asked about if teeth cleaning needed, doc said no because teeth looked good but still said maybe can do it in a few months, and bonus can remove a small bump (wart) too at same time so let us run you an estimate. I said ok I’ll see an estimate but then the clinic called a week or so later to ask if I wanted to get the dog on the surgical schedule for that month as it was filling up. That was strange if it was not really needed right away. I asked who would do the surgery and learned it was not the previous surgeon we had who did the teeth cleanings (owner doc). So then I went down an internet wormhole. The owner doc sold this practice to Vet strategy that is merged with IVC evidensia and that is owned by EQT that is a group of private equity investors. Enough of this. I remove my dog from this clinic and hope I can find a new place for my senior dog. Some docs here are good and 1-2 remain from before and I hope they can find a new employer because this business model has to stop being involved in the care of our companion animals. Our family doesn’t want to be a part of it.

Great Vet clinic. We have been taking our cat there for a few years.

I went for my dog's yearly check up yesterday at Roncy Vet. Clinic- as always the service is great and staff is sensitive and responsive. The pricing for the visit was great, no extra tests ran and only vaccines needed. I have been going to this clinic for 18 years and this is my second dog. All vets that have looked after our dog at the clinic are great.
Great team, friendly and helpful.

I’ve been bringing my cats to this clinic for over 10 years, and once again, they delivered exceptional care. During our visit yesterday, the entire team was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. They took the time to clearly explain the situation, walk us through the treatment plan, and make sure we felt fully informed and comfortable with next steps.
It’s not always easy navigating pet health concerns, but their professionalism and genuine compassion make a real difference. I’ve always felt that my pets are in good hands here, and that trust has only grown over the years.
I truly appreciate the consistency in quality care and communication. As long as I live nearby, I will continue bringing my cats here without hesitation.

After searching for the right vet clinic, we can confidently say that Roncy Village Vet has the best team we've encountered. Their staff is compassionate, caring, honest, and truly dedicated to the well being of animals. What stood out most was their approach. They never pressured us into aggressive or unnecessary treatments (unlike other clinics out there *-*). Instead, they took the time to explain our options, provide thoughtful recommendations, and be transparent about what was truly needed. Their genuine care, empathy, and integrity are exactly what every veterinary clinic should strive for.

Been taking both my cats here, Madison and Dirty, and they are amazing. My cats are very sketchy around people but with Roncy they are very calm. These animals are our children and support and if you want to give yours the best care, Roncy is th place. Ps they even call afterwards to check up and make sure all is good. Thanks Roncy
The best veterinary clinic, so lucky to have found it. Always very caring and patient with all my questions. Thank you for being so amazing!
They are so kind and informative, every time I go I learn so much about my cat!
Roncy vet clinic staff are absolutely wonderful
Thank you Jonathan for a 5-star review. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

Thank you Quy for a 5-star review. We look forward to seeing you again soon

Big thanks to Dr. Jordan and the Roncy Vet team! Took Paco in for his annual checkup + vaccines and couldn’t be happier. Dr. Jordan was knowledgeable, kind, and took the time to answer all our questions. Paco loved all the treats during his examination which kept him calm.  Great  visit. Highly recommend!
Your positive feedback motivates us, Nancy! We look forward to seeing you again soon.
Love the clinic! They have been great with our 3 month old puppy.
Friendly, efficient and caring!!

We’ve been clients of this clinic, which makes this experience particularly disappointing.

We called multiple times during the day for help with our dog’s ear infection and were told someone would call back, but no one did. After repeated follow-ups, we were told to come in for a swab.

When we arrived, we were questioned about coming without an appointment, despite being instructed to do so.

The veterinarian was unable to perform a proper ear examination and only completed a swab, yet we were charged a full $160 examination fee without any clear disclosure that this would apply despite the limited nature of the visit.

We raised this concern afterward and requested a reconsideration, but it was declined.

Clients should be made very clear on fees and expectations before proceeding.
Dr Jordie was very patient and caring with my dramatic pooch, thank you so much
Thank you for the 5 stars, Amy. We're so glad we exceeded your expectations.

After a series of bad vet experiences we found Roncy VIllage Vet a couple of years ago. They are fantastic, always thorough, fair in pricing and genuinely have our pet's best interest in mind. They go above and beyond to help and are never judgmental of the decisions we make. We have recently moved out of the city but continue to come here for our dog, totally worth the drive.
Your positive feedback motivates us, Catherine! We look forward to seeing you again soon.
We appreciate you taking the time to leave a 5-star rating. Thank you for your support.

I previously informed you and kindly request that you do not waste my time. We explicitly asked for the laser you offer for removal of histiocytoma , and if you do not possess the laser machine, please do not advertise it or use it as bait to coerce customers into surgery.

Two weeks have been wasted on Bella; we could have moved on and not left a one-star review.

Please be honest and straightforward. If you do not have the laser, state that clearly and do not use it as bait to manipulate customers' emotions.

Goodbye.

Such friendly staff and the vet treated my polydactyl cat’s nails with such care. Would highly recommend!

We've been with Roncy for two years and have been pleased with the care our dog has received. However, we've experienced several service issues, so we've decided to leave the clinic. We've noticed that management hasn't been responsive to our concerns, especially regarding the online store, which is a third-party service with flawed policies. They have become too big and arrogant to be trusted. We have no confidence in services that do not listen and attempt to fix issues that need fixing.
Always friendly, timely and thorough. Always know we will get the best of care for Phoenix (our dog!).
Roncy Village Vet is always amazing with the dogs and very understanding and compassionate! Great service always!

Every Staff (from phone call, to email, to in-person) has been amazing! I have always felt comfortable bringing my cat in as I knew she would be treated with care, understanding and gentleness. The Vets and Vet Techs are helpful and informative, and are always eager to help figure things out. I would not hesitate to recommend Roncy Village Vet Clinic to everyone and will continue to bring my cat here. Pancake loves them!!

I’ve been taking my dog here for the last 4 years, very friendly staff and every vet who has taken care of her has been great. Vet care these days is expensive and the way everyone here treats my dog makes it worth every penny. You can tell they all genuinely care about animals!
The obvious high level of veterinary health services is combined with the true concern and loving care of their patients!
Very helpful and friendly staff. We waited a little longer than we wanted, but they were busy. Everyone was extremely knowledgeable and gentle with our dog.
Always have excellent experience here. Dr Jordy was exceptional in caring for our 14 year old dog after a coyote bite and then followed up after.  Thank you!!

I can't say enough great things about Roncy Village Vet Clinic - Dr. Amina Johnson in particular is hands down the best vet I've ever taken any of my pets to. She's taken such great care of my aging 14.5 year old pug over the last few years, when we've had to come in for emergencies and regular care. You can tell the whole clinic genuinely cares for all their patients and owners. Even in the last few months when they've been incredibly short-staffed and experiencing more stress on the clinic because of that, everyone there is so warm and really doing their best to still go above and beyond. All of the techs and reception are amazing too. I feel so fortunate to have found such a great clinic for my dog!

Taking care of our furry friends is so important! They bring so much love and joy into our lives with their compassionate and adaptable nature. If you’re looking for a trusted vet, we can’t recommend ours enough! The whole team is incredibly friendly and supportive. Dr. Johnson is especially amazing—so caring and always there to help us with whatever we need, like making arrangements to fly our pup back home. It's such a relief to have that kind of support!
Amazing service each and every time. Friendly and kind group of people. My Bella is always in good hands🥰 …

Our dog Chloe went in for her annual checkup. The vet, Dr Amina Johnson was really great. She was open and honest about any questions we asked her. I felt very confident in her as someone to look after my dog.
Best vets around 10/10 would highly recommend them to anyone!

You can see my initial review.  The staff were incredibly awesome.  Past tense purpose.  That has definitely changed over the past several months.  The transition to vet strategy has been a complete and utter disaster.  It is quite clear in a money saving move that they have decided to cut every single corner possible...starting with the front of the line staff that were the ones mainly responsible for keeping my guy happy.  A year ago, this spot was worth 5 stars...now I feel generous even offering one.  If they can't treat staff properly I really question their ability to handle my dog

"My very large boy can be quite hard to handle, but the staff are amazingly accommodating and empathetic to his needs.  They go out of their way to make sure he is very comfortable.

Would like to particularly shout out Dr. Johnson for everything today, as well as both Aly and Kita in the front.  Never thought I would see the day where this guy would be excited to go to the vet"
Just had a laparoscopy surgery for our Golden Retriever. Everything went well, she recovered quickly ! Thank you!

Dr Johnson and her team are outstanding! I’ve had many pets & visited many vet clinics & she is the absolute best! I’m never blindsided by the invoice. She’s always honest & upfront about everything. My dog Harley loves going to the vet!

This is a corporate veterinary business with I believe over 15 locations across Canada. Their other nearby location is Bloorcourt vet, which I’ve also been to . While this office is the better of the two, they’re always going to provide you the most expensive services, with at times very poor communication and after care. I’ve been to Roncy with my cats, and while we did encounter some amazingly kind receptionist staff, the vets were hit or miss. It always felt like they had pressure on them to sell and book unnecessary follow up appointments(at cost).

I would really recommend people search out veterinary officers where the owner is a vet and involved in the practice. They are usually far more invested in your pet’s well-being and less about the bottom dollar. Smaller offices do have their limitations, but they are always able to refer you to larger animal hospitals for more specialized care.

Welcoming and caring staff! My puppy is always happy to visit this place.
Pricing on the higher end.

listen to parents concerns 💖

Amazing clinic! The whole team is super caring and responsive. Have been seeing them for the past 7 years and have never been disappointed by their service. Highly recommend.
You know when you know people love what they do and it shows and is felt from the minute you walk in with your pet till the minute you leave? Well that’s Roncy Village Vets!

Every single member of the Roncy Village team is a gem. They are so caring and conscientious. We have taken all of our pets to them over the years. After moving a bit farther from Roncy, we tried a different vet once and immediately regretted it, returning quickly to Roncy for the level of care and professionalism that our fur babies deserve. We are so thankful to have them!

Where do I even begin? I’ve had to spend many hours at the vet over the last few years trying to help an ailing (supremely beloved) pet, but the people of Roncy Village Veterinary Clinic did their best to make a difficult time more bearable.

They were so thorough, flexible, compassionate, kind and — when some levity was needed — funny. Right up to the end, Dr. Johnson and the team went above and beyond to make sure we knew they hadn’t given up on finding solutions for my sick little guy. And when we’d exhausted everything and he became too sick to go on, I felt completely supported in the heartbreaking decision to end his suffering. I would definitely recommend them to anyone in Toronto looking for a trusted vet clinic.

I have made Roncy Village Vet Clinic my regular checkup spot for my cat, Eevee, and the experience with Dr. Amina Johnson and the Vet Techs has always been more than positive for both me and my kitty. I believe they do a thorough job of examining pets and will ask if there's any issues to address, and will follow up on how things are going since the last visit. The team has been very gentle with Eevee every visit and you can tell they love their animal clients.

I am always more than happy to consult the team on concerns that I have, or even getting advice on how to integrate new pets into our lives, and I'm very confident in the team's ability.

Thanks RVV team from me & Eevee!
Friendly and helpful receptionists. Knowledgeable, experienced staff.

My cat was diagnosed by my local vet with baldder stones but my local vet doesn't do any laparoscopic urethral or bladder stones removal or surgery. I looked around and I called this clinic 2 months ago ,I was told that they do this type of intervention and I booked an appointment. When it was the time to drive the cat to the appontment, I receiced a phone call that the doctor has reviewed my cat's reported problems and actually the clinic doesn't do the specific surgery laparoscopically. They do it regularly and she quote 5200 $ ,my own vet quoted 2200 $.I was suggested to drop off the appointment ,and I did ,they made me lose time as I stop searching and getting other vet clinics opinion. I called them again few days ago as I seen they have a vet who speaks my language and I really wanted to check again with him what exactely they do laparoscopically as I was puzzeled by conflicted informations. After I calld few times,left message and sent an email (I did not get a response to either voice message or email) I called 15 min before the closing hour and a very rude person responded. She said I cannot speak with the doctor in my own language for 2 minutes , butto book with him an appointment for a second opinion,I have to go through her,to book an appointment with him ,weeks down the road. She rudely implied I want to get a vet advise for free and when I stated that I am not trying to get a vet advise for free  but to understand what surgeries are they offering ,she asked me to lower my voice. I am sure I did not raised my voice!My own vet always talks to us on the phone if we need clarifications and email to us  the results or her advise after we seen her but it seems the Roncy Village is not a  customer friendly  clinic. I felt very upset after interacting twice with these people ,I received wrong informations,the receptionist don't know what procedures are done by whom,they have no patience and the last one was rude.In what way  would I prejudice the clinic if I would have spoken in my own language with the doctor to clarify once and for all what procedure they do and and would my cat benefit? I would book an appointment with him in confidence and might do the surgery with him or a colleague he trusts and recommends.I am very dissapointed and never again will contact this people.

This is my cat's vet clinic. The staff are always so friendly and take the time to educate and reassure nervous clients. They also offer free water. I have brought my cat here to get her nails trimmed by the vet techs and they go above and beyond. #ContestEntry
Thank you Danitza!
Very friendly stuff that are very attentive.
bad service and advice
Thank you for being one of our very first clients 15 years ago, Huntly! It's been an honour to care for your family's kitties and we're grateful for your trust in our team <3

I’ve been taking my Shiba Inu here for 7 years. I have yet to see a consistent veterinary that handles his care, it is always someone different that assesses him. After an over priced assessment fee, they never know what’s wrong with him. They give me a list of options is could be and then recommend the most outrageous treatment: oral surgery, Neurological assessment, MRI, X-rays, blood work, colonoscopy, etc. They are Always saying that we need to vaccinate and do all these preventative measures BUT THEY NEVER KNOW WHATS WRONG WITH HIM. After seven years, I’ve decided to call it quits on them. I don’t know how there are winning awards.
Very thoughtful and caring staff. Took great care of my kitty.
amazing caring and understanding staff!

I have had animals my whole life and have dealt with many vets. By far Roncy Village Veterinary has been the most compassionate, profession and clearly cares about the animals they are treating. If you need a vet I highly recommend Roncy village vet.

I have been taking my cats to Roncy Village Veterinary Clinic for several years and this clinic is the BEST!  The doctors are all amazing, have taken excellent care of my four-legged sweethearts, are caring, and offer amazing advice. The …

Great group of vets and techs who treat your pets with the love and respect they deserve.
